changes: Added Antigravity CLI as the current third Lattice host runtime via agy; kept Gemini as deprecated legacy compatibility; updated runtime probes, dispatch policy, guard/session semantics, capability profiles, docs, and smoke scripts.
usage: Run node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity --json or --host=agy --json; run node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_list --json to see fake,codex,claude-code,antigravity current runtimes.
expectedOutcome: host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity shows host=antigravity and cliCommand=agy; --host=agy aliases to antigravity; host_runtime_list shows codex, claude-code, and antigravity as current real hosts; Gemini appears only as deprecated legacy compatibility.
actualTranscript: Observed: host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity returned host="antigravity", requestedHost="antigravity", status="scaffolded", cliCommand="agy", commandPath="/Users/jek/.local/bin/agy". host_runtime_probe --host=agy returned host="antigravity", requestedHost="agy", matchedFallback=true, cliCommand="agy". host_runtime_list returned fake, codex, claude-code, antigravity. npm --prefix packages/main run test:unattended-dispatch-smoke and npm run test:authority-enforce-matrix both passed.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible mismatch: expected Antigravity/agy current-host behavior and smoke commands matched actual output. Authority state remains local/non-authority as designed.
limitations: No production Authority receipt is claimed. Antigravity remains supervised/scaffolded and unattendedSafe=false until a bounded runner/policy proves stronger execution semantics.
pitfalls: Initial review exposed stale Gemini-current assumptions in guard-session, docs, and smoke tasks; final fix required adding missing npm scripts and host-guard-matrix coverage before DONE gates could pass.
